title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Prompt-Settlement Allowance Schedule
content:
**Schedule.** On a total-loss vehicle surrendered under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, when the settlement is accepted more than 60 days after the loss was reported, 1.5 percent of the adjusted value, rounded to the cent, is added to the surrender settlement; when it is accepted more than 30 but no more than 60 days after the report, 0.75 percent of the adjusted value, rounded to the cent, is added; when it is accepted within 30 days of the report, nothing is added. Days are counted from the report date to the acceptance date, the report date not counted.

The adjusted value is the vehicle value less the prior damage deduction. The report date is read from the claim's loss report; the acceptance date is the date the customer accepts the settlement.

| Days from the report date to the acceptance date | Allowance added |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | Nothing |
| 31 to 60 | 0.75 percent of the adjusted value, rounded to the cent |
| 61 or more | 1.5 percent of the adjusted value, rounded to the cent |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical dates, adjusted value 17600.00)

- Loss reported on March 1, settlement accepted on March 31: 30 days (March 1 not counted), nothing added.
- Accepted on April 1: 31 days, 0.75 percent of 17600.00, that is 132.00, added.
- Accepted on April 30: 60 days, 132.00 added.
- Accepted on May 1: 61 days, 1.5 percent of 17600.00, that is 264.00, added.
